message.content:
The **C♯ major** scale consists of the following seven notes (plus the octave):

| Step | Note |
|------|------|
| 1    | C♯ |
| 2    | D♯ |
| 3    | E♯ |
| 4    | F♯ |
| 5    | G♯ |
| 6    | A♯ |
| 7    | B♯ |
| 8 (octave) | C♯ |

> **Intervals**: Whole – Whole – Half – Whole – Whole – Whole – Half

> **Enharmonic equivalents**:  
> - E♯ is the same pitch as F  
> - B♯ is the same pitch as C  

So the C♯ major scale can also be written as: **C♯, D♯, E, F♯, G♯, A♯, B, C♯**.
